note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_parenting.py; type=manual require agent/render inspection.

GATE_1_authority_and_evidence.text: Active Medical Authority declared in Phase 0 and consistent throughout; AAP or NHS never mixed; no US guidance in a UK book or vice versa
Every developmental milestone presented as a range with an upper professional-consultation threshold; no fixed-age 'will' statements
Every statistic and study verified live with source and date recorded; none from memory or framework docs
Safe-sleep guidance matches the current Active Medical Authority recommendation
Feeding guidance non-judgmental; covers breastfeeding and formula appropriately
Immunization section directs to the current live schedule resource rather than reproducing a static schedule
No invented baby-name etymologies; uncertain origins labeled uncertain; variants documented as legitimate

GATE_2_structural_completeness.text: Stage-based or age-band chapter structure consistent throughout for the Active Sub-Genre
'When to Call the Professional' box present in every health-adjacent chapter
Each box contains 3-8 specific actionable indicators and specifies an urgency level
Milestone Reference Chart (developmental books) present in back matter with range data and Active Medical Authority citation
All appendices carry practical value; stage-appropriate tools (birth plan, hospital bag checklist) included; no generic filler
Baby-name entries follow the fixed entry sequence (name, origin, meaning, pronunciation, variants, optional associations, optional siblings)

GATE_3_voice_and_safety.text: Reassurance-with-honesty voice consistent: no false cheerfulness, no unnecessary alarm
Postpartum depression content uses clinical language and directs to professional support; no claim that lifestyle/devotional practice alone treats it
Neurodiversity acknowledged in milestone and developmental content
Professional referral language present wherever grief, mental health, domestic violence, or abuse is mentioned
Crisis and support resources verified live for current contacts and regional suitability; no static carryover
No legal advice about divorce, custody, or family law; readers directed to a family law attorney
No before-and-after body imagery in pregnancy/postpartum chapters

GATE_4_production_and_kdp.text: Front matter in correct order per Book Architecture; page numbering begins with Introduction as page 1
Back matter complete: Conclusion (~1.5 pages), Milestone Chart where applicable, Appendices, Resources
Times New Roman throughout, 12 pt body, 1.15 spacing; When-to-Call boxes visually distinguished and consistently formatted
One chapter-opening image per chapter generated and inserted at any page count; every image has caption and alt text
Projected page count falls within the sub-genre page band (defaults; competitor research may override)
Images show diverse realistic families; no idealized-body comparisons; no dangerous-behavior demonstrations
Uniqueness audit passed: chapter structure, milestone data, voice, and examples distinct from any prior parenting book this session
Final DOCX renders cleanly: no clipped tables, broken headings, or orphaned section titles; auto-TOC populated
